name: Chin-Up
summary: A pull-up variation with an underhand grip that shifts more work to the biceps while still training the lats and upper back. Usually a little easier than the overhand pull-up.
setup: Grab the bar with an underhand (palms facing you) grip about shoulder width.
Hang with arms straight, ribs down and legs slightly in front.
Set the shoulder blades down and back before you pull.
execution: Pull the elbows down and forward toward your hips.
Continue until your chin is above the bar without craning the neck.
Pause briefly at the top with the chest toward the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang with straight arms.
mistakes: Using only the arms: start each rep by pulling the shoulder blades down.
Swinging or kicking the legs: squeeze the glutes and abs and reduce speed.
Stopping short of a full hang: lower until the elbows are straight on every rep.
Grip too narrow for the wrists or elbows: use shoulder width or slightly wider.
